label: A signal measured in standard errors
section: A signal measured in standard errors
subgoals: Divide the gap by the standard error

visual.title: A statistic measured in standard errors
visual.caption: The z statistic is the gap between the estimate and the null mean divided by the standard error. The curve is the standard normal, and the observed line is that number of standard errors from zero.

predict.question: A z statistic of 2.2 is tested at alpha 0.05. What is the decision?
options: Fail to reject because 2.2 is below 1.96
Reject because the two-sided p-value is below 0.05
predict.explain: The two-sided p-value at 2.2 is about 0.028. It is below 0.05, so the null is rejected.
